::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 24th 1859  
**From:** Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/  Yonge 1859/7
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)
Here is [£8..4 for your kind hel](organizations/other_102.qmd)p in the course of the last half year.  I think [Frances](other_books/otherbook_265.qmd) has been entirely successful.  The sole criticism I have heard is that she might have found plenty of misery at the West End - but then as her father was a landowner in the East, I think she had every call thither.

Thank you for your promise of a story for that far away date Christmas twelve month.  I did mean one of the [Aggesden](other_books/otherbook_268.qmd) kind of length, but I think stories settle their own length better than one can do it for them beforehand.

I hope [Mr Parker](people/person_1143.qmd) will soon think the times good enough for Aggesden

[the rest missing with the signature]

---

**Note:** Envelope addressed to Miss A C Smith/ Rectory/ Old Charlton/ London/ SE and postmarked Winchester 24 June 1859 and London SE 25 June 1859.  The paper has been cut to remove the signature.
